pages.title: Gold Door - Keycraft Guide
pages.text: The Gold Door between the two workshop rooms stays locked until the key vendor's first visit. The vendor arrives on the morning of day 3 and leaves a Gold Key near the door for the taking. Before day 3 the door cannot be opened, no matter what; spend the time gathering whatever is on your side.

pages.title: Crown - Keycraft Guide
pages.text: The Crown is crafted at the workbench from 3 Wood and 2 Stone. Press KeyC next to the bench with the materials in your pack. The bench room also holds most of the workshop's materials.

pages.title: Workshop Notices - Keycraft Guide
pages.text: Workshop notice boards can be read by facing them and pressing KeyE. They post vendor schedules, including the key vendor's day-3 visit.
